residual_calibration.interpretation: Disagreement with the SNPP reporting scale, not uncertainty about true fires or burned area.
residual_calibration.guarantee: No guaranteed coverage under temporal dependence, historical shift, or repeated historical model development.
residual_calibration.cell_warning: Aggregate bands are fitted after aggregation. Do not sum cell intervals.
residual_calibration.history_warning: Terra-only and other unsupported historical regimes require separate sensitivity flags; band width does not fully quantify extrapolation bias.

bootstrap.method: Resample four complete two-year blocks with replacement, refit ratio and learned expert, freeze mixture weights
bootstrap.interpretation: Descriptive training-data variability range, not calibrated historical predictive coverage. Model-family/mixture selection is not rerun.

limitations: Residual bands measure reference-scale disagreement, not true fire activity.
Previously inspected calibration years and temporal/spatial dependence prevent nominal coverage guarantees.
Bootstrap refits measure training-year variation of this frozen mixture; they do not quantify all selection uncertainty or historical sensor/algorithm bias.
Before Aqua operation the deployed baseline fallback is retained; historic residual-band coverage is unvalidated.
Bootstrap percentile ranges are separate from predictive residual bands; neither is an interval for burned area or true fire count.
